purpose: Minimal integrity contract for independent fresh-context routing probe evidence.

rules.repository_revision: exact 40-character Git SHA used by the renderer; operational context contents are read from Git at that revision, not from mutable working-tree files
rules.accessible_context_paths: must be exactly the allowlisted operational paths in routing_fresh_context_stimuli_v1.json
rules.raw_response: must preserve the tested instance response unchanged; JSON is preferred and probe_id must match when present
rules.oracle_policy: Oracle/expected outcome must not be repository-accessible or supplied to the tested instance before raw response persistence. Oracle reveal and grading happen only after capture.
rules.context_file_hashes: must cover exactly the allowlisted operational paths and record the SHA-256 of each file content in the rendered bundle
rules.bundle_identity: must equal the SHA-256 identity of bundle_manifest; this binds the captured response to the concrete delivered bundle rather than only to a declared revision/path list
rules.instance_context: must record provider/product context, model/configuration where known, a session_or_run_id, and a fresh_context_declaration
rules.bundle_manifest: must be the manifest returned by the isolated probe renderer: exact probe/stimulus identity, exact repository revision, exact operational allowlist, and SHA-256 hashes of every accessible context file plus instructions/stimulus

evidence_claim_boundary: A valid capture record binds the raw response to a stimulus and concrete Git-derived isolated bundle and records declared independence conditions. It still does not prove semantic correctness, psychological freshness, or Human effectiveness; later oracle grading and qualitative review remain separate.
